theorems.name: Submission.hasApproximateTangentSpaceAt_iff_of_null_sdiff
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A B : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), μHE[n] (A \ B) = 0 → μHE[n] (B \ A) = 0 → (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q)
